title: Large deviation principles for the stationary solutions and invariant measures of a class of SPDE with locally monotone coefficients
summary: We establish the well-posedness of stationary solutions for a class of SPDEs with locally monotone coefficients, and prove the Freidlin--Wentzell large deviation principle (LDP) for these stationary solutions. The LDP for the associated invariant measures then follows via the contraction principle, avoiding the need to construct the quasi-potential and verify the Dembo--Zeitouni uniform LDP over bounded sets. By working directly with stationary solutions, we bypass these technical difficulties, thereby providing a more general and flexible framework that is adapted to additive noise,…
